source.title: Cancellation of WCA Asian Championship 2020
source.content:
With great sadness, we have to announce the cancellation of WCA Asian Championship 2020 due to the COVID-19 outbreak. Although this competition was previously announced to be postponed, there are no longer plans to reschedule this competition for a later date. 

We appreciate the community's kind understanding during these unfortunate times.

translation.title: 2020 WCA 亚洲锦标赛取消
translation.content:
很遗憾，由于新冠疫情，我们不得不宣布取消 2020 WCA 亚洲锦标赛。虽然此前已宣布延期，但现在不再计划另择日期举办本届比赛。

感谢社区在这段困难时期的理解。
